fields.description: Off: delivery costs stay exactly what the carrier quotes. On, with the rate card as the price source: customers pay from the rate card. On, with the carrier: the rules below are kept, but for now the website still charges the carrier's own prices.

fields.description: Carrier: the carrier's price with the rules below, but for now the website applies the policy only with the rate card, so customers still pay the carrier's own prices. Rate card: customers pay from the interim rate card and the carrier is not asked.
fields.label: Price source

fields.description: Edited in the wizard (Rates step); this is the stored copy.

fields.options:
Pass the carrier price through

fields.options:
Don't offer delivery
Charge a fixed amount
Free

fields.description: Rules are checked from top to bottom. The first enabled rule whose conditions all hold is used.
